propositions: Bedrock Converse outputConfig (native structured output) is rejected client-side by botocore 1.40.61 due to ParamValidationError before any network call.
The wire feature requires botocore >= 1.43 to function.
Current botocore is locked at 1.40.61 because aiobotocore caps boto3 < 1.40.62, creating a dependency diamond with pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock].
The existing tool.uv conflicts block forks eval and bedrock/dev resolution, allowing independent version constraints for each extra.
Raising the floor to botocore >= 1.43.0 and boto3 >= 1.43.0 for the bedrock extra preserves the eval fork at 1.40.61 without breaking resolution.
